name: Baron Zemo

abilityDetails.Fury: Saldırı gücünü geçici olarak büyük ölçüde artırır.
abilityDetails.Cleanse: Bu etkiye sahip şampiyon bir debuff aldığında, debuff anında arındırılır ve Cleanse kaldırılır.
abilityDetails.Root: Köklenen şampiyonlar hareket edemez ama saldırabilir, bloklayabilir ve kaçabilir; özel saldırı Root'u kaldırır.
abilityDetails.Resistance Up: Fiziksel Direnci ve Enerji Direncini belirtilen güçte artırır.
abilityDetails.Decelerate: Unstoppable ve Kaçış (Evade) yetenek doğruluğunu sabit bir miktarda azaltır.
abilityDetails.Bleed: Zamanla doğrudan fiziksel kanama hasarı verir.
abilityDetails.Disorient: Savunma yetenek doğruluğunu ve blok yeterliliğini belirtilen güçte azaltır.
abilityDetails.Sunder: Kritik Direncini sıfıra indirir ve artmasını engeller.

howToPlay: Bu şampiyona karşı (savunmada): Ona negatif efekt uygulama — 5 tanesini purify edince köklendirir. E1'e zorla, hiç negatif efekt uygulama. Pasif yetenek azaltıcı şampiyonlar da iyi çözüm.
bestUse: Bu şampiyon genel maceralarda ve Skill sınıfı avantajı olan yollarda en iyi performansı gösterir.
signatureAbility:
The Master of Evil
Zemo gains +[95.48 - 1,000] Critical Damage Rating and can perform Critical Hits through the Opponent's Block.
When fighting #Heroes, attacks that intercept the Opponent gain +[95.48 - 1,000] Critical Rating.

abilitySections.title: Basic Attacks
content: For Zemo's Medium Attacks, he wields a gun. These attacks do not make contact.
Whenever the Opponent Purifies a Debuff or is Immune to an effect, Zemo gains a Fury Buff increasing the Attack Rating of his next hit by +[20,532]. Max stacks: 15.

abilitySections.title: Your Defeat Is Certain
content: Zemo's personal Bleeds are indefinite Debuffs that deal [164.26] Direct Damage per second.
All of Zemo's personal effects can be inflicted through Block.

abilitySections.title: Grand Machination
content: Enter each fight with 5 indefinite Cleanse Passives. Zemo's Cleanses can't Purify Stun Debuffs.
When Zemo runs out of Cleanses, he inflicts a Root Passive on the Opponent for 5 seconds and gains a [2,750] Resistance Up Passive for 15 seconds.
While this Resistance Up is active, Zemo can't gain Cleanses. When Zemo has no personal Resistance Up or Cleanses active, he gains 5 indefinite Cleanse Passives.

abilitySections.title: Right Where I Want You - Root
content: When the Opponent becomes Rooted, they are inflicted with an indefinite 50% Decelerate Passive. Max Stacks: 2.
While the Opponent is Rooted, their Combat Power Rate is reduced by 40% and Zemo's is increased by 40%. Additionally, Zemo's attacks can't Miss and all his hits inflict an indefinite Bleed Debuff.
If the Opponent breaks free of Zemo's Root before it expires, inflict 5 additional indefinite Bleed Debuffs, reduced by 1 for each Prowess effect they have.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: On activation, inflict an indefinite Disorient Passive reducing Block Proficiency by 25% and Defensive Ability Accuracy by 10%. Max Stacks: 4.
The final hit inflicts an indefinite Bleed Debuff.
If the Opponent is Rooted, pause Root for the duration of this Special Attack and the final hit inflicts 5 additional indefinite Bleed Debuffs.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: The final hit inflicts a Root Passive on the Opponent for 5 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: Inflict a non-stacking indefinite Sunder Passive reducing Critical Resistance to 0 and preventing it from increasing.
This attack gains +[1,539.9] Attack Rating for each of Zemo's indefinite effects the Opponent is suffering.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - The Master of Evil
content: Zemo gains +[95.48 - 1,000] Critical Damage Rating and can perform Critical Hits through the Opponent's Block.
When fighting #Heroes, attacks that intercept the Opponent gain +[95.48 - 1,000] Critical Rating.
